messages.subject: legend formatting
parts:
I am having difficulty getting my legend to format correctly.  I have two problems. The first is that neither byrow = TRUE or bycol = TRUE seems to change the layout of the legend.  Below is the code I am using 

ggplot(Chem.comp, aes(Course, GRADE)) + geom_boxplot(notch = TRUE,aes(fill = COHORT))+ 
       labs(y ="Grade Points in class", 
       x = "Chemistry 2 quarter") +
       ggtitle(expression(atop("Comparison between \nISE cohorts and Peers", atop(italic("in Chem 2 classes"), ""))))+
       ylim(0,4.3333)+
       scale_fill_manual(name = "ISE Cohorts &\nComparison groups", 
                                 values = c("blue","red","blue3","red3","blue4","red4")) +
       theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", colour = "black", vjust = -1))+
       guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3),bycol = TRUE)

ggsave(file="ChemBoxISEbycol.pdf")

and I get the two attached plots setting  bycol=TRUE and byrow =TRUE in the guides() call.
The goal is to have all the reds in one column and all the blues in the second.

Which brings me to the second problem, which is more of a question.  Could the legend be set up like lattice pot (sort of) in that I could label each row and column and not each entry?  That is could I have some thing like?
ISE   CMP
                 2007
                 2008
                 2009

Thanks Robert
